title: Deployment settings (private store, settings.yaml)
description: Functional addresses and names the setup steps need. Lives in the private store next to the people list (decision 0006); holds no instructor data.

library.description: SharePoint document library that holds the private store (decision 0006)

dpo_email.description: Data protection contact named in the ROPA entry and the notice

notice_version.description: Privacy notice version; used in file names and the [tm-notice <version>] tag

pilot.description: Optional, additive within major 1 (decision 0016). True marks a pilot store that holds artificially generated data only: roster import refuses any instructor whose email is not on a reserved domain. A store in a personal OneDrive folder must set it.

dev_autosign.description: Optional, additive within major 1 (owner, 2026-10-27). True makes `teachermodel daily` run `dev-autosign` (generated sign-offs, for development) instead of a plain tick. Allowed only in a pilot store: it requires pilot: true.

simulated.description: Optional, additive within major 1 (decision 0020). True marks a store written by `teachermodel dev-simulate`: everyone in it is generated, and its notice text renders although the templates still carry draft markers, with a SIMULATED DATA first line. Allowed only in a pilot store: it requires pilot: true.
